name: @porcelain/desktop
description: Where agent work becomes trusted work.
author: Fabio Fiorita <fabiolfp@gmail.com>

scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:node && pnpm typecheck:web && pnpm typecheck:mobile-tests && pnpm typecheck:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && PLAYWRIGHT_FORCE_ASYNC_LOADER=1 playwright test --project=browser e2e/critical-wiring.spec.ts e2e/canvas.spec.ts e2e/composed-proof.spec.ts e2e/actions.spec.ts e2e/git-promotion.spec.ts e2e/hub-inventory.spec.ts e2e/hub-viewer.spec.ts e2e/diff-wrap.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:prebuilt: PLAYWRIGHT_FORCE_ASYNC_LOADER=1 playwright test --project=browser e2e/critical-wiring.spec.ts e2e/canvas.spec.ts e2e/composed-proof.spec.ts e2e/actions.spec.ts e2e/git-promotion.spec.ts e2e/hub-inventory.spec.ts e2e/hub-viewer.spec.ts e2e/diff-wrap.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: pnpm build && PLAYWRIGHT_FORCE_ASYNC_LOADER=1 playwright test --project=browser e2e/critical-wiring.spec.ts e2e/hub-inventory.spec.ts --grep '(authenticated startup restores|an external fixture edit refreshes|Hub inventory creates)'
scripts.test:e2e:smoke:prebuilt: PLAYWRIGHT_FORCE_ASYNC_LOADER=1 playwright test --project=browser e2e/critical-wiring.spec.ts e2e/hub-inventory.spec.ts --grep '(authenticated startup restores|an external fixture edit refreshes|Hub inventory creates)'
scripts.test:e2e:pairing: pnpm build && PLAYWRIGHT_FORCE_ASYNC_LOADER=1 playwright test --project=browser e2e/pairing.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:visual: pnpm build && PLAYWRIGHT_FORCE_ASYNC_LOADER=1 playwright test --project=browser e2e/visual.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:update: pnpm build && PLAYWRIGHT_FORCE_ASYNC_LOADER=1 playwright test --project=browser e2e/visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.test:e2e:native: pnpm build && PLAYWRIGHT_FORCE_ASYNC_LOADER=1 playwright test --project=electron e2e/terminal-native.spec.ts e2e/hub-environment-switch.spec.ts e2e/environment-nickname.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:native:prebuilt: PLAYWRIGHT_FORCE_ASYNC_LOADER=1 playwright test --project=electron e2e/terminal-native.spec.ts e2e/hub-environment-switch.spec.ts e2e/environment-nickname.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:native:update: pnpm build && PLAYWRIGHT_FORCE_ASYNC_LOADER=1 playwright test --project=electron e2e/terminal-native.spec.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.shots: pnpm build && PLAYWRIGHT_FORCE_ASYNC_LOADER=1 playwright test -c playwright.shots.config.ts
